article.name: How to Upgrade to 10Web Pro Plans
article.title: How to Upgrade to 10Web Pro Plans
article.body:
We recommend starting with a 7-day free trial of our Pro plans to enhance your web hosting experience with 10Web. This gives you the opportunity to explore our features and services before committing. If you're already confident in your choice, you can skip the trial and purchase your preferred Pro plan directly from our website.

10Web Pro plans overview

Our Pro plans are divided into three categories: Business, E-commerce, and Agency, each offering a variety of options to suit different types of websites and business needs. Choose the category and plan that best fits your requirements.

Note:

With the exception of the Agency category and its plans, all other categories and their plans offer, as a default, one hosted website. For more information please visit our pricing page.

Upgrade from 10Web dashboard 

You can upgrade from multiple parts of the dashboard. Here are the two main ways you can upgrade from the dashboard.

From the website dashboard:

  1. Click the Manage button to get into the website dashboard.
  2. Click the Main tab
  3. Click Get 10Web Free for 7 Days. You will be redirected to the pricing page in your dashboard.
  4. Click the plan category tab you want (Business, Ecommerce or Agency)
  5. Choose the plan you want
  6. Choose to pay monthly or annually
  7. Click Get it Free
  8. Fill in your payment information
  9. Click Secure Checkout

Note:

If you want to skip the 7 day free trial and purchase the plan, go to the pricing page and click Buy Now.

Anywhere from the dashboard:

  1. Click the green diamond button. You will be redirected to the pricing page in your dashboard.
  2. Click on the plan category tab you want (Business, Ecommerce or Agency)
  3. Choose the plan you want
  4. Choose to pay monthly or annually
  5. Click Get it Free
  6. Fill in your payment information
  7. Click Secure Checkout

Important:

We will send you an email 24 hours prior to the expiration of your trial period. If you do not cancel when the 7 day free trial expires, you will be charged for the chosen platform plan.

Upgrade from 10Web.io   

  1. Log in to your account
  2. Access 10web.io
  3. Click Generate Your Website. You will be redirected to the pricing page in your dashboard.
  4. Click on the plan category tab you want (Business, Ecommerce or Agency)
  5. Choose the plan you want
  6. Choose to pay monthly or annually
  7. Click Get it Free
  8. Fill in your payment information
  9. Click Secure Checkout

Quick tip:

Choosing to pay annually saves you up to 50%.

If for any reason your upgrade has failed, please contact us via live chat located at the bottom right of your screens.
